thread:
alex_k: Hey team — quick heads-up: our weekly RFC review (Weds 9:00am PT) is spawning duplicate calendar invites and a couple of people say the Zoom link doesn't match the one in the agenda doc.

maria_g: seeing it too. I got two invites for the same recurring series (one from my personal calendar, one from the team calendar). The personal one has an old zoom link.

calendar-bot: detected 7 duplicate invites in the last 24h for event "RFC Review" (recurring series id: 0a1b2c). Recommend owner transfer.

sam_t: likely cause: original series was created with alex's personal Zoom account. when alex switched accounts, zoom generated new meeting ids and Google kept the old conferencing on some instances.

olivia_r: ugh. Also some folks have the shared team calendar subscribed and then accept a direct invite — that makes two entries for them. Calendar UX is annoying.

alex_k: plan: I can create a new series owned by the Team Zoom account (redwood-eng@zoom). Steps I propose:
- Duplicate the current event in GCal
- Edit conferencing -> select "Redwood Team Zoom (redwood-eng@zoom)"
- Save & send updates to guests
- After confirmation from a few folks, cancel the old series with a short note explaining the switch
Any objections?

jordan_m: 👍 do that. When you duplicate, please copy the description (agenda + pinned links). Also set the event to "Guests can modify" = off so folks don't fork invites.

maria_g: add a line in the description: "If you see two events in your calendar, keep the one with conferencing id: 123-456-7890 and delete the other." That will help people who have both.

sam_t: small nit — when you cancel the old series, choose "Cancel entire series" and send cancellation. Google sometimes leaves ghost occurrences if you delete single instances.

olivia_r: timezone check: a few EMEA folks asked if we can nudge to 9:30am PT (45m later) to avoid late evenings for them. Can we poll quickly?

alex_k: created a 2-question poll: preferred staying 9:00am PT / moving to 9:30am PT. Link: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123 (please vote)

calendar-bot: reminder: if you're using ICS export/import into Outlook, duplicate invites can appear if both the shared calendar and the invite are accepted. Best practice: subscribe to the shared calendar only OR accept the invite, not both.

maria_g: also FYI — if you manage multiple Zoom accounts, go to Google event -> Conferencing -> "Change conferencing" -> pick the company account. If the field is greyed out, re‑create the event under the desired account.

sam_t: for completeness, here's an RRULE snippet if anyone is editing via API/ics:
```
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=WE;COUNT=999
```
Keep start time as 09:00 PT.

olivia_r: voted. if we move, please update the calendar description with a timezone conversion table (PT/ET/BST/CET/IST) so folks don't guess.

alex_k: will do. I'll: 1) duplicate -> create new series on team zoom 2) paste agenda/links + timezone table 3) send a short note explaining the swap and ask people to delete any duplicates 4) cancel old series after 48h if no issues.

jordan_m: recommend calling out "do not click re-invite/copy to calendar" — some folks click that and spawn dupes.

maria_g: thanks. also tagging eng-sre for FYI in case any automation reads older series ids for perf rollouts.

alex_k: noted. I'll post an update here when done and ping anyone who still sees issues. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: action scheduled: new-series created draft by alex_k (will send invites once alex saves)
